_about: Manifest of diagnostic ground-truth chord fixtures for the audit bench. Rebuilt 2026-05-19 after the original untracked diagnostic GT set was lost to a git-clean incident. Each fixture is concert-pitch with capo:0 (the convention of the three fixtures that survived the incident). Schema matches audit/score_chord_chart.py / score_chord_chart_v2.py: {song, artist, key, capo, sections:[{name, lines:[[bar,...],...]}]}. One line cell == one bar. GT-vs-GT scores 1.0 on every axis of both scorers for all entries.
